demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Three wells completed and brought into commercial production during the year, contributing to an increase in field production.
- The North Balol two-well development drilling programme is expected to contribute to an increase in gas production from the field.
- Well K#17 in Kanawara encountered a 24-metre hydrocarbon zone in a new fault block, establishing the presence of producible hydrocarbons.
- Wet-gas discovery in the younger Cambay Shale section, with initial testing of approximately 18,000 SCMD of gas along with 5 m³ per day of oil condensate.
- Sector outlook is driven by energy demand, …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- MD&A flags exploration, drilling and operational uncertainties that may affect the cost, timing and commercial viability of exploration and development activities.
- MD&A names fluctuations in crude oil and natural gas prices as an industry threat and a key influence on sector outlook.
- MD&A flags regulatory changes; the proposed change in participating interests under the Carried Interest Agreement awaits requisite Government approval.
- MD&A lists availability of capital and technology among the risks affecting exploration and development.
- MD&A states the industry includes established domestic and international companies with significant financial resources, technical expertise and operational capabilities; competition turns on access to exploration opportunities.
- All six producing fields named (Kanawara, North Kathana, Allora, Dholasan, North Balol, Unawa) are in the Cambay Basin, and the business is carried on through subsidiaries.
- MD&A names environmental considerations as a risk for exploration activities.
- Notes state certain loans are interest free, described as a violation of Section 186(7) of the Companies Act, 2013, and that confirmations of balances due to/from parties have not been received.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Develop and produce hydrocarbons from the existing portfolio of producing Cambay Basin fields while undertaking further exploration, appraisal and development to enhance production and unlock additional hydrocarbon potential.
- Augment the oil and gas production and reserves base through development drilling in existing fields (seven-well Kanawara/North Kathana campaign; two-well North Balol campaign).
- Restructure participating interests in certain fields under a Carried Interest Agreement, subject to Government approval which is awaited.
- Consolidate the operating subsidiary structure: …
